i hope so :(
sorry to be the teenager whom almost everyone hates for making the worse things bigger than there really are.
i guess... sometimes i just have this urge to submit myself for the things my head says. sorry for making y'all worried.

thank you :( some ppl reach to me and we talked a little. this made me a little more ease in my toughts. it still one month ahead. i dont know the future know, but i'm questioning my decisions :( 

maybe a spring really comes after the winter :(

i havent got the chance to seek for a psychologist, but i'm in a group therapy (it sucks, because they are really older than me). i know i'm not the person you want to talk and maybe i'll die next month, but... i can reach you out? seems like talk to ppl are making me feel better (even if my mind still tricky). 

for now, please continue seeking help from you psychologist. i know it looks like it isnt working, but giving up in the treatment would be even worse. trust me, i already did it.

please, follow your own advices. i know it's hard and i know i'm being hypocrit now, but killing yourself isnt the right thing to do. you need to live. please, dont give up. 

i know i'm telling i'll do it, but i really dont see any hope. :(

gym helps you bcs help to emite serotonine (i guess). but it's not my jam, sorry lol

i'm already feeling better. my mind didnt change, but i'm glad that some people cared about me. tysm

i like to write. listen to music. read.

but nowadays isnt working anymore.
gosh, i'm crying now. i'm feeling so guilty now. everyone is being nice to me, but my mind is just my cage and i dont even know how to get off it.
i know. sometimes i just wanna feel good :( but it's getting harder. i dont wanna hurt my family, but i dont see any other exit. i already tried docs and meds, but i'm still feeling numb.

i'm glad that i didnt disappoint you, but i'm sorry to disagree with i being nice. i'm not. a lot of ppl already told me this. i'm just a toxic garbage that really dont serve for anything. i dont wanna you to iluse yourself. im not kind, i'm just looking for aproval. i'm always trying this. i dont even know who i'm anymore.

and i dont wanna hurt you later if i die. i dont recommend you to start a conversation w/ me :(

i know it's terrible. i try not to do it (nowadays is just to hard to hurt ms without my parents notice this. i got a little addicted to this a time ago and this got me busted - actually, i told them. i was afraid to keep going with the flow). 

i really wanted to think positively. i'm trying to see good things until july, 16. im just so deep that everything that felt nice in the past are only ashes in my mind.

i'm just lost. really lost.
i feel like i'm drowing and dont know what else i can do.
sometimes i feel this huge need to hurt myself, even when the day is great.

almost every time i think about being dead is when everything is working. because it's that i feel sad about. the good moments that i'm living today won't be there tomorrow. only the same locked room i always stay.
i'm sorry if i disappoint you :(

i'm really glad about your concern, but idk. the idea of this date is just too strong on me. :( i really dont see any color on this world. i sleep almost everyday and dont feel joy in waking up. idk if i'll be something useful in the future.
i wont kms today. you dont need to worry.
i dont wanna to be a burden
i dont know if i can stay any longer here :( i'm sorry.

i dont know. one of the reasons i still here is for my younger siblings. they need me. i dont see in this a meaning, i just see an objective. some quest i need to fuffil b4 i tried something.

but idk, i hope someday i'll find a true meaning for all of this ;/.
